quote: Mehdi Behzad introduced the total coloring conjecture during his Ph.D. studies in 1965. His Ph.D. thesis, titled 'Graphs and Their Chromatic Numbers,' was completed at Michigan State University in 1965.
note: Behzad introduced the conjecture in his 1965 Ph.D. thesis. Vizing independently made a related conjecture around 1968. Behzad is credited as the first to pose the conjecture.
